posts.cooked:
Yeah the cards you discarded sounded alright, though if you have multiple copies of them you always want to discard the lowest for redirection, and save the highest for Starshield if you ever get it into play.

 

Though there are a couple of errors in your play. NightMist can only redirect the first time she was dealt damage, which would of been Heedless Lash, so you would redirect that 3 and would take the 4 damage from Scouring Mist. Also putting Scouring Mist into play is slightly different than Playing a card, so you wouldn't regain HP for chaining it. So you would only be at 3 less HP while Akash would have 1 more HP. Went ahead and fixed it in the Doc. Still a very good turn though!
